formal_core.statement: God, in the Christian notion as rigorously stated by Polkinghorne, is the self-authenticating ground of all that is — not an entity among entities, but the source of all; the one whose deepest reality is relational (perichoresis: the mutual exchange of love between the three Persons); veiled in his encounter with finite humanity; aseity (being-in-itself) who does not call for evaluation by any other criteria. Epistemic structure: the economic Trinity (God as experienced) is the immanent Trinity (God in himself) — Rahner's rule: approach from below, experience is trustworthy.
formal_core.grade: A (structure: the rigorous definition of the Christian notion) / C (identification with the thesis's machinery — God as the coherence of the whole; the Veil; the compatibility condition as the divine self-limitation / kenosis)
